stage.familyTagline: Handcrafted culinary crafts and mindful rituals designed for the whole family.
stage.collectiveBody: A private, bespoke sanctuary bringing specialty coffee, mindful nourishment, and artisanal comfort together under one warm roof.
stage.coffeeBody: A reflection of calmness and exploration. We source and roast with intention to craft the perfect specialty cup for every moment.
stage.papaBody: Balanced meals and mindful choices. Clean energy and wholesome ingredients that reflect vitality, balance, and confidence.
stage.mamaBody: Nurturing flavors and generous portions. Comfort food, freshly baked sourdough, and handcrafted treats that feel like coming home.

showroom.intro: Explore our complete trilogy of crafted menus. Swipe or select any booklet to unveil our curated roasts, mindful wellness recipes, and comforting home classics.

story.communityText: Where coffee, food, and people come together.
story.intro: Voya House is more than just a destination — it is a welcoming sanctuary where specialty coffee, nourishing healthy food, and comforting family meals live together under one roof.
story.communityBody: Whether you’re stopping by for a quick morning espresso, enjoying a fresh healthy meal, or sharing a table with your loved ones on the weekend — there is always a place for you at Voya House.
story.coffeeBody: From single-origin beans to intentional roasting, our specialty coffee is an invitation to slow down, explore delicate notes, and enjoy quiet moments of calm.
story.papaBody: Wholesome bowls, crisp salads, and clean balanced meals crafted to give you steady energy, strength, and vibrant vitality throughout your day.
story.mamaBody: Generous comfort dishes, artisanal pizzas, and sweet treats made for sharing. Warm hospitality and familiar recipes that make you feel right at home.

footer.quote: Every sip a new trip. Designed for the journey.
